title: Credit card statement ready
description: Tell cardholders their monthly statement is ready, with total due and due date. A transactional WhatsApp template for card issuers.
notes: State the total and minimum due so the message stands on its own; do not promote installment plans in the same text.

body.text: Hi {{first_name}}, your {{month}} credit card statement is ready. Total due: *{{total}}*, minimum payment: {{minimum}}, due on {{due_date}}. You can pay from the app.
